QUESTION: Will the Ellsworth Falls Village Council adopt Ordinance 2026-14, the Riverwalk Overlay, at its regular session on 8 September 2026?
DEADLINE / CUTOFF: 2026-09-08T22:00:00-04:00
RESOLUTION NOTE: YES only if the ordinance receives the affirmative votes the village charter requires at the 8 September session. A failed or tied vote, or adoption at any later session, does not count.

  e1 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-24T00:00:00-04:00] The Ellsworth Falls Village Council has five members: Adaeze Okonkwo, Minh Tran, Rosa Delgado, Gareth Pryce, and Carla Bianchi. (source: Village website, council roster)
  e2 [verified, public, as of 2026-09-01T00:00:00-04:00] The council's regular session is scheduled for Tuesday 8 September 2026 at 7:00 PM at the village hall, and the published agenda lists final action on Ordinance 2026-14, the Riverwalk Overlay. (source: Published council agenda, 2026-09-01)
  e3 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-24T00:00:00-04:00] The village charter sets quorum at three members and provides that adopting an ordinance requires the affirmative vote of at least three members of the full five-member council. (source: Village charter sec. 2.07)
  e4 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-24T00:00:00-04:00] Council rules require members to be physically present in the chamber to vote, and there is no remote-participation provision. (source: Council rules of procedure)
  e5 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-25T21:00:00-04:00] Okonkwo sponsored Ordinance 2026-14, stated at the 25 August work session that she supports it, and told the clerk she wants final action taken at the 8 September session. (source: Work session minutes, 2026-08-25)
  e6 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-25T21:00:00-04:00] Tran stated at the 25 August work session that he is prepared to vote for Ordinance 2026-14 as drafted. (source: Work session minutes, 2026-08-25)
  e7 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-27T00:00:00-04:00] Delgado told the Ellsworth Falls Courier on 27 August that she opposes Ordinance 2026-14 and intends to vote against it. (source: Ellsworth Falls Courier, 2026-08-27)
  e8 [verified, public, as of 2026-09-01T00:00:00-04:00] Pryce wrote in his 1 September constituent newsletter that he opposes Ordinance 2026-14 in its current form and intends to vote against it. (source: Pryce constituent newsletter, 2026-09-01)
  e9 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-24T00:00:00-04:00] Bianchi co-sponsored Ordinance 2026-14 and has publicly supported it since June. (source: Ordinance filing and council statements)
  e10 [verified, public, as of 2026-09-02T16:00:00-04:00] Bianchi filed written notice with the village clerk on 2 September that she is absent from the 8 September session to attend her daughter's naval academy induction in Annapolis that evening. (source: Clerk's absence file, 2026-09-02)
  e11 [verified, public, as of 2026-08-24T00:00:00-04:00] Under council rules an item listed for final action is voted on at that session unless its sponsor moves postponement. (source: Council rules of procedure)
